### Passing integration: BNDigital

BNDigital became the **30th maintained source family** as a deliberately small three-route first-party link-only starter. The source stores destination URLs plus WebNR-authored labels/descriptions and does not mirror or fetch book text, OCR, scans, PDFs, images, audio, catalog records, search results, metadata, credentials, account state, or rights statements. It adds no crawler, origin API client, proxy, background synchronization, or new reader-format capability.

A richer BNDigital adapter remains gated on source-specific endpoint, item-rights/attribution, access/terms, browser transport, file identity, update/deletion, pagination/cadence, resource/failure, format, and versioned-fixture evidence. `Web Novel Discussion Radar Starter` remains unchanged at **12** link-only routes.
